claim_limitations: Exact rational centre/half-angle certificate derived here from the 8313686 decimal layout: every centre and the side as printed, each half-angle tangent tan(theta/2) rounded down at 40 places, from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records; no upstream byte is retained, and the author's own exact certificate is not public. register.title: Rio Calle's n102 arrangement at 8313686, issue529
register.headline: Another arrangement of Ryan Xu's design for 102 squares, certified exactly from its decimal layout
register.source_checks: The author reports that verify_exact.py, a 60-digit decimal separating-axis check over 931 nearby pairs and the walls, finds least gaps of 1.932e-12 between squares and 2.002e-12 to the walls, and that the author's private search engine's exact rational-interval certificate accepts the layout, with the same layout in a box 1e-11 smaller refused by both; both checkers were written with Claude and share no code. Run once here from scratch on the pinned layout and its JSON copy, verify_exact.py printed the same two gaps over 931 close pairs; it rounds at 60 digits, so it is no exact check, and the private engine's certificate cannot be replayed.
register.credit: Credit Rio Calle (https://github.com/riocalle/my-repo, University of New Hampshire) with this arrangement, found by the author's own search engine (GPU simulated annealing, an exact LP finish and a beam search of structural edits) from scratch, and credit ry-xu (T-125) with finding the design and width first, as the issue asks: ry-xu published at 2026-10-08 00:03 UTC and the author's search finished its first packing of the design about ten hours later. The issue and README state AI assistance: the author designed and directed the project and its experiments, and Claude wrote and ran the code, the GPU search, the exact finishing step, the refinement search and both checkers.
register.next_rung: Independently review the derived certificate and its replay, then decide registration: the certified side is below T-125 by 5.48e-11 but above the case's ceiling, Evan Daniel's regularization of ry-xu's packing (T-146), by 2.43e-11, so it moves no case. Measured for the credit, it matches ry-xu's packing one to one under a half turn of the box, 40 squares within 1e-9 and 62 moved, 19 beyond a tenth of a unit: another arrangement of ry-xu's design, not a refinement of his packing. Final exact-head CI remains required.

bibliography.note: A decimal layout of 102 unit squares at 831368623f2d4dcef2e9434fd85c3e154083c97d, centres and radian rotations at 18 significant digits, of the design ry-xu published first (T-125); the record's exact certificate is derived here, every decimal read as printed and each half-angle tangent rounded down at 40 places, and kept as a derived fact. No licence: no upstream byte retained. The author's 60-digit decimal checker was run once outside the repository; the author's exact engine is private. AI assistance stated: Claude wrote and ran the search, finishing, refinement and checking code under the author's direction. No local or global optimality is registered.
